svg.title: SARIMA seasonal-order backtest evidence
svg.desc: Three-panel chart of fictional daily container returns. The first panel marks ordered training, validation, and final test periods. The second ranks six seasonal-order candidates by validation mean absolute error. The third compares the selected SARIMA model with a seven-day seasonal-naive baseline by forecast horizon on the untouched test period.
